senses.gloss:
ध्यात,
 
-ध्यान, -ध्यानिक &c. See under ध्यै; ध्यातं वित्तमहर्निशं नियमितप्राणैर्न शम्भोः पदम् [[Bh. 3. 13.]]
p. p. [ध्यै-क्त] Thought of, meditated or reflected upon.

a. Unclean, dirty, black, soiled; [[Bk. 8. 71.]] 
-मम् A kind of grass.

m. 
__1 Measure. 
__2 Light. -n. Meditation (less correctly ध्मामन्).

ध्यातव्य,
ध्येय a. 
__1 To be meditated upon, to be contemplated. 
__2 Fit for meditation; ध्येयः सदा सवितृमण्डलमध्यवर्ती [[Viṣṇudhyānam.]] 
__3 To be imagined or conceived.

[ध्यै-भावे-ल्युट्] 
__1 Meditation, reflection, thought; contemplation; ज्ञानाद् ध्यानं विशिष्यते [[Bg. 12. 12]]; [[Ms. 1. 12]]; 6. 72. 
__2 Especially, abstract contemplation, religious meditation; तदैव ध्यानादवगतोऽस्मि [[Ś. 7]]; ध्यानस्तिमितलोचनः [[R. 1. 73.]] 
__3 Divine intuition or discernment. 
__4 Mental representation of the personal attributes of a deity; इति ध्यानम्. 
-Comp. 
-गम्य a. attainable by meditation only; योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यम् [[Viṣṇustotra.]] 
-तत्पर, -निष्ठ, -पर a. lost in thought, absorbed in meditation, contemplative. 
-धिष्ण्य a. suitable for ध्यान; रूपं चेदं पौरुषं ध्यानधिष्ण्यम् [[Bhāg. 10. 3. 28.]] 
-मात्रम् mere thought or reflection. 
-मुद्रा a prescribed attitude in which to meditate on a deity. 
-योगः profound meditation. 
-स्थ a. absorbed in meditation; lost in thought.
a. Sought or obtained by pious contemplation or abstract meditation; ध्यानिकं सर्वमेवैतद्यदेतदभिशब्दितम् [[Ms. 7. 82.]]

a. contemplative, engaged in religious meditation. 
-बुद्धः, -बोधिसत्त्वः a spiritual Buddha.
